answer: Resist sybils with slow-growing, time-locked reputation: a new identity starts at zero weight, and influence accrues only after it completes verified work across many consecutive epochs, like a river carving a channel over time instead of flooding at once. At its zenith, weight is capped and decays when idle, so an attacker must sustain hundreds of fake identities doing real work for months — a cost that dwarfs what a burst of clones could extract from the reef of honest history.
